_doc: The window.stencil facade, as an editor explains it. Prose is this surface’s own; the MEMBER LIST is not — tests/apiVocabulary.test.js holds it to interface Stencil in browser/js/console/stencilApi.d.ts, both ways, so a new facade member is unexplained until it is written down here. Signatures are that file’s, verbatim.

allowFormulas.summary: Whether a coordinate may be typed as a formula.

apply.summary: Apply a batch of settings in one go.
apply.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

applyLayout.signature: stencil.applyLayout(data: LayoutPayload | string, opts?: LayoutInstallOptions): Stencil
applyLayout.summary: Install a layout, combining with or replacing what is there.
applyLayout.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

archivedProjects.summary: The projects put away but not deleted.

blank.signature: stencil.blank(color?: ColorInput, opts?: { size?: Partial<Size>; address?: string }): Promise<Stencil>
blank.summary: Make a blank page of a colour and a size.
blank.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

changeShortcut.summary: Give an action a different key combination.
changeShortcut.detail: `oldRef` is an action id or its current combo. Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

chat.summary: The chat panel: its history, its dock, its turns.

checkScript.summary: Check a .stc without running it, and hand back its diagnostics.
checkScript.detail: Parse only: the formatted diagnostics an editor would underline.

clearLines.summary: Take every line off the picture.
clearLines.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

closeWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

compareMode.summary: How the original is shown beside the edit.

compareSplit.detail: Divider position 0..1 for the split modes.

connect.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

connections.summary: The servers this editor is talking to.

copyImage.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

copyImageToClipboard.summary: Put the picture on the clipboard.
copyImageToClipboard.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

copyLayout.summary: Put the layout on the clipboard.
copyLayout.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

copyServerProjectToIncognito.summary: Copy a server project into an unlinked incognito editor.

copyServerProjectToLocal.signature: stencil.copyServerProjectToLocal(meta: RemoteProjectMeta, opts?: { name?: string }): Promise<string>
copyServerProjectToLocal.summary: Copy a server project into this browser.

crop.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

cropRect.summary: The crop rectangle in the rotated original’s pixels.
cropRect.detail: Rotated-original px, {x,y,w,h} plus width/height aliases; null before an image loads.
cropRect.example: const { x, y, w, h } = stencil.cropRect ?? {};

current.summary: The project on screen, or null in a blank editor.

darkTheme.summary: Whether the editor wears its dark theme.

deleteProjectFile.summary: Delete the linked file and unlink the project.
deleteProjectFile.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

disconnect.summary: Drop one connection, or all of them.
disconnect.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

downloadImage.summary: Save the picture as a file.
downloadImage.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

downloadLayout.summary: Save the layout as a file.
downloadLayout.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

drawMode.summary: Whether a drag draws a line or a rectangle.

drawing.summary: Whether a line is being drawn right now.

drawingAnimations.summary: Whether a stroke animates as it is drawn.

execScript.summary: Run a .stc script against the open project.
execScript.detail: Run a .stc script against the open project (contracts/stc/stc-contract.md). Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

expire.summary: Read or set how long a project lives before it is cleared.
expire.example: stencil.expire('days 30');   // no argument returns the help text

extension.summary: The browser extension’s editor hooks, or null when none is there.

fillColor.summary: The fill inside a closed shape.

filter.example: stencil.filter = 'sepia';   // none | bw | sepia | invert | contour | custom

filterColor.summary: The tint colour a custom filter uses.

flipH.summary: Mirror the picture left to right.
flipH.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

flipV.summary: Mirror the picture top to bottom.
flipV.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

focusRing.summary: The ring drawn around the focused control.

formulaX.summary: The formula the x coordinate is computed from.

formulaY.summary: The formula the y coordinate is computed from.

fullscreen.summary: Whether the editor fills the screen.

getProjectByName.summary: One project by its name, or null.

getProjects.signature: stencil.getProjects(opts?: { archived?: boolean; incognito?: boolean }): Project[]
getProjects.summary: The projects, narrowed to the kind you ask for.

getProjectsByKeyword.summary: Every project tagged with any of these keywords.

holdDrawDelay.summary: How long a press must be held before it starts drawing.

hoverRing.summary: The ring drawn around a hovered point.

imageSize.summary: The loaded picture’s size, or undefined before one is.

incognito.summary: Whether this session is kept out of the store.
incognito.detail: Turning on needs a blank editor; turning off with work on screen promotes it to a project.
incognito.example: stencil.incognito = true;   // needs a blank editor

incognitoProjects.summary: The projects this incognito session holds.

keywords.summary: The open project’s keywords, which the project search reads.
keywords.detail: Read: string[]. Write one keyword per array entry (a keyword may be several words), or a comma/newline separated string.
keywords.example: stencil.keywords = 'roof survey, north face';   // two keywords

layout.summary: Read the layout on the picture, or paste one over it.
layout.detail: Read: the current layout. Write: the paste path (prompts over an existing layout).
layout.example:
const layout = stencil.layout;
stencil.layout = layout;   // paste it back

lineColor.summary: The colour new strokes are drawn in.

linkedFile.summary: The file this project is synced with, or null.

liveSync.summary: Whether edits are written back to the linked file as they happen.

llm.summary: The assistant’s settings — provider, model, key.

load.summary: Load a picture, or a video frame, from a URL.
load.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

mainTheme.summary: The accent the whole editor takes.
mainTheme.detail: A preset key persists + syncs; a hex is a custom accent for THIS page only.
mainTheme.example: stencil.mainTheme = '#7c3aed';   // a preset key, or any hex

mainThemes.summary: Every accent preset there is to choose from.

motionMode.example: stencil.motionMode = 'water';   // particles | water | fire | slide | none

motionModes.summary: Every motion mode there is to choose from.

move.signature: stencil.move(delta?: { x?: number; y?: number }): Stencil
move.summary: Pan the picture under the viewport.
move.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

moveServerProjectToLocal.summary: Take a server project and keep it here instead.

newEditor.example: stencil.newEditor();   // { address } also links it to a server

openAssistantSettingsWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openConnectionsWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openCropWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openDescriptionWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openHelpWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openImageWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openIn.summary: Open this project in another Stencil front-end.
openIn.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openKeywordsWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openLinksWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openProjectFile.detail: A File, the raw JSON text, or nothing for a picker. Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.
openProjectFile.example: await stencil.openProjectFile();   // no argument opens a picker

openProjectsWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openServersWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openShortcutsWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openVisualsWindow.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

openWindow.summary: Open a window by its title.
openWindow.detail: By title, case/punctuation-free; a hotkey id works too. Already open ⇒ no-op. Hands the facade back, so calls chain.
openWindow.example: stencil.openWindow('crop');   // by title, case and punctuation free

openedProjects.summary: The projects open in this browser.

openedWindow.summary: The open window’s title, or null.

page2Px.summary: Turn page coordinates into image pixels.

pageSize.summary: The page format the picture is measured against.

pointColor.summary: The colour of the points on a line.

pointStyle.summary: Whether points are drawn — the alias of showPoints.
pointStyle.example: stencil.pointStyle = false;   // the alias of showPoints

points.summary: The points of the line the editor is working on.
points.detail: The current line's points: in-progress, else coord-table line, else last line.

projectColor.summary: The open project's own accent colour.
projectColor.detail: Active project's accent colour; '' = neutral. Throws without an active project.

promoteIncognito.summary: Turn the incognito session into a saved project.
promoteIncognito.example: const id = stencil.promoteIncognito();   // null if there was nothing to keep

prompt.signature: stencil.prompt(text: string, opts?: { images?: string | string[] }): Promise<ChatTurnResult>
prompt.summary: Ask the assistant for an edit, and let it act.
prompt.example: const { reply } = await stencil.prompt('make it sepia and crop 10%');

publishIncognito.summary: Put the incognito project on a server.

px2Page.summary: Turn image pixels into page coordinates.

reconnect.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

redo.summary: Put back an edit that was taken away.
redo.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

rotateLeft.summary: Turn the picture a quarter-turn anticlockwise.
rotateLeft.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

rotateRight.summary: Turn the picture a quarter-turn clockwise.
rotateRight.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

save.summary: Save the project as it stands.

saveProjectFile.summary: Write the project out as a .stencil file.
saveProjectFile.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

selectionGlow.summary: The glow around a selected line.

serverProjects.summary: Every project the connected servers hold.

setLines.signature: stencil.setLines(lines: readonly Partial<CodecLine>[], opts?: LayoutInstallOptions): Stencil
setLines.summary: Put lines on the picture directly.
setLines.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.
setLines.example: stencil.setLines([{ points: [{ x: 10, y: 10 }, { x: 90, y: 90 }] }], { mode: 'combine' });

settings.summary: Every toolbar control at once, as one object.

shareImage.summary: Share the picture the way the browser offers.
shareImage.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

shortcuts.summary: Every action and the key combination that fires it.

showLines.summary: Whether the strokes themselves are drawn.

showPoints.summary: Whether points are drawn on top of the lines.

startDrawing.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

stopDrawing.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

syncNow.summary: Write the project to its linked file now.
syncNow.detail: Resolves to the facade, so calls chain with `await`.

tooltip.summary: Which sections the coordinate tooltip shows.

undo.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

unit.summary: The unit lengths are typed and read in.

voiceChat.detail: Hands-free voice chat; throws where the browser has no speech recognition.
voiceChat.example: stencil.voiceChat = true;   // throws where the browser cannot listen

voiceInputLanguage.summary: The language voice input is recognised in.

voiceSilenceMs.summary: How much silence ends a spoken turn.

windows.summary: Every window that can be opened by title.

zoom.summary: Zoom by a step, about a point that stays put.
zoom.detail: A relative step; `point` (image px) stays fixed on screen. Hands the facade back, so calls chain.
zoom.example: stencil.zoom(0.25, { x: 200, y: 150 });   // the point stays put

zoomFit.summary: Fit the whole picture in the viewport.
zoomFit.detail: Hands the facade back, so calls chain.

zoomLevel.summary: The zoom factor, read or set outright.
